key_news.headline: Lam Research Deepens Investment in Boise to Support U.S. Semiconductor Manufacturing
key_news.summary: Opened new 9,200 sq. ft. office in Boise, Idaho, initially supporting ~150 personnel focused on collaborative R&D and high-volume manufacturing of Micron's leading-edge memory technology. Part of multi-year strategy to increase operational and innovation velocity for AI-era chipmakers.

key_news.headline: Lam Research Announces Participation at Morgan Stanley TMT and Cantor Conferences
key_news.summary: CFO Doug Bettinger will present at Morgan Stanley TMT Conference (March 3, 2026, 9:15 AM PST) and Cantor Global Technology & Industrial Growth Conference (March 11, 2026, 7:40 AM PDT). Live audio webcasts available via investor relations.

key_news.headline: Sen. John Boozman Discloses Sale of LRCX Shares
key_news.summary: U.S. Senator John Boozman disclosed sale of Lam Research shares. Congressional stock trading in semiconductor companies under heightened scrutiny.

key_news.headline: Director Eric Brandt Sells 35,000 Shares ($7.9M)
key_news.summary: Director Eric Brandt sold 35,000 shares for approximately $7,896,150. This follows a prior sale on Feb 6 of 18,000 shares for ~$4,140,000. Total Feb sales by Brandt: 53,000 shares (~$12M).

key_news.headline: Board Declares Quarterly Dividend of $0.26 Per Share; Sesha Varadarajan Appointed COO
key_news.summary: Board approved quarterly dividend of $0.26/share. Sesha Varadarajan appointed Chief Operating Officer, succeeding Patrick Lord who retires March 6. Part of orderly leadership refreshment.
key_news.source: Lam Research Investor Relations / Simply Wall St

key_news.headline: Dr. Anirudh Devgan (Cadence CEO) Joins Board of Directors
key_news.summary: Dr. Anirudh Devgan appointed to Lam Research Board. Devgan is CEO of Cadence Design Systems, bringing EDA and semiconductor design expertise to the board.

key_news.headline: Lam Research and CEA-Leti Expand Multi-Year R&D Collaboration for Specialty Technologies
key_news.summary: New multi-year agreement with CEA-Leti to accelerate pathfinding of new materials and processes for lower-power, high-performance specialty technology applications including MEMS, 3D imaging, sensors, RF, photonics, and quantum optics. Lam Prestis PLD system is integral to the research.

key_news.headline: Q2 FY2026 Earnings Beat: Revenue $5.34B, EPS $1.27 vs. $1.17 Expected
key_news.summary: December quarter revenue of $5.34B (vs. $5.23B consensus), marking 10th consecutive quarter of growth. EPS $1.27 beat by $0.10. Gross margin 49.7% exceeded high end of guided range. Full year CY2025 revenue $20.6B (+27% YoY). Diluted EPS $4.89 (+49% YoY).

key_news.headline: Q3 FY2026 Guidance: Revenue $5.7B, EPS $1.35; WFE to Reach $135B in CY2026
key_news.summary: March quarter guidance: revenue $5.7B (+/-$300M), gross margin 49% (+/-1pp), operating margin 34% (+/-1pp), diluted EPS $1.35 (+/-$0.10). CY2026 WFE spending forecast >20% growth to $135B from $110B in CY2025.
key_news.source: Lam Research Earnings Call / Seeking Alpha

key_news.headline: China Revenue Expected Below 30% in CY2026; 50% Affiliate Rule Creates ~$600M Headwind
key_news.summary: Management expects China revenue mix to decline below 30% of total in CY2026, down from 43% in Q1 FY2026 ($2.28B). Beijing's 50% affiliate rule (requiring chipmakers to use >=50% domestic equipment) creates ~$600M CY2026 revenue headwind (~$200M Q2 impact). Lam expects to offset with stronger global AI-driven demand from Taiwan, Korea, and U.S.

key_news.headline: DeepSeek AI Sell-off Hits Semiconductor Equipment Stocks
key_news.summary: LRCX down 5.6%, KLA -6.3%, ASML -6.5%. DeepSeek's $6M AI model raised questions about AI chip demand trajectory. Impact proved temporary with stocks rebounding within days, but highlighted market sensitivity to AI capex narrative shifts.

key_news.headline: Multiple Analysts Raise LRCX Price Targets; Consensus 'Strong Buy'
key_news.summary: 25 analysts maintain average 'Strong Buy' rating. Forward P/E at 35.93x, above 3- and 5-year averages. Stock appreciated 185% in 12 months ending Feb 2026.

key_news.headline: Lam Research Comments on New U.S. Export Regulations
key_news.summary: Dec 2024 U.S. export controls expansion. 50% affiliate rule restricts shipments to specific Chinese customers. Lam stated impact 'broadly consistent with prior expectations'. Estimated $200M Q2 revenue drag, ~$600M CY2026 drag.

key_themes.ai_driven_wfe_supercycle: WFE spending forecast >20% growth to $135B in CY2026 from $110B in CY2025. Lam holds ~45% plasma etch market share. AI driving increased etch/deposition intensity per wafer across NAND, DRAM, and foundry/logic.
key_themes.china_headwind: 50% affiliate rule + export restrictions = ~$600M CY2026 revenue headwind. China revenue expected <30% of total in CY2026, down from 43% in Q1 FY2026 ($2.28B) and 37.4% of FY2025 total. Management confident non-China demand offsets.
key_themes.advanced_packaging_growth: Advanced packaging business (electroplating, TSV etch) expected to grow >40% in 2026. Direct beneficiary of HBM, chiplet, and AI packaging trends.
key_themes.valuation_stretch: Forward P/E at 35.93x, well above 3- and 5-year averages. Stock up 185% in 12 months ending Feb 2026. 25 analysts maintain 'Strong Buy' but stretched multiples noted as risk.
key_themes.leadership_refreshment: New COO (Sesha Varadarajan), new board member (Anirudh Devgan, CEO of Cadence), multi-year CEA-Leti R&D partnership. Signals strategic positioning for next growth phase.
key_themes.specialty_tech_diversification: CEA-Leti partnership targets MEMS, 3D imaging, sensors, RF, photonics, quantum optics via Lam Prestis PLD system. Longer-term SAM expansion beyond leading-edge logic/memory.
key_themes.deepseek_narrative_risk: Jan 27 DeepSeek sell-off (LRCX -5.6%) demonstrated vulnerability of AI capex narrative. Any evidence of AI spending deceleration or efficiency gains reducing chip demand = outsized stock reaction.
